summary.text: Matt Nunn is a Republican member of the Kentucky Senate representing District 17, serving since 2025. The legislature's profile lists Nunn as chair of the Senate Enrollment Committee and co-chair of the Budget Review Subcommittee on Economic Development & Tourism, Natural Resources & Environmental Protection.

paragraphs.text: According to the legislature's profile, Matt Nunn was born on January 6, 1978, and is self-employed.
The profile lists a B.A. from Eastern Kentucky University, Kentucky Army National Guard service in 1996-2008 and 2013-2021, and membership in Rotary and the American Legion.
